alpha_selection.rule: pre-registered: alpha in {0, 0.5, 1}; choose by dev metric; exact ties go to the larger alpha
alpha_selection.dev_metric: corpus primary metric delta (final - initial) on the dev auxiliary split
alpha_selection.scope: glm4-9b x 4 tasks x 16 dev items, forced-refinement arm (fixed_rounds)
alpha_selection.why_forced: alpha only governs which experiences are retrieved, so it can only be measured where retrieval affects the round; with adaptive stopping the controller declined to refine on 26-32 of 32 items and the comparison was vacuous
alpha_selection.note: 0.5 has the best cross-task sum and wins the largest-magnitude task (zh_en); it is also the pre-registered default, so no post-hoc tuning was applied

draft_cache.reason: vLLM is not bit-deterministic at temperature 0.1, so regenerating drafts per sweep point changed the starting condition (corpus BLEU on the same 16 dev items was 32.51 in one pass and 38.21 in the next). Drafts are generated once and replayed.
draft_cache.verified: init metric is byte-identical across alpha=0.0/0.5/1.0 and the warmup pass

y0_reuse.user_decision: keep stored drafts despite the 77/80 gate result
y0_reuse.reason: reusing the stored text is the only way to guarantee a byte-identical y0 across arms; regenerating is subject to the same nondeterminism and would align worse with the published Direct-Zero baseline
y0_reuse.must_report: 77/80 = 96.25% exact reproduction, all 3 mismatches on wmt19_zh_en, plus the same-seed repeat probe

dev_gate_random_control.why: the random_retrieve arm uses adaptive stopping, so the controller stopped immediately (rounds=1.0-1.12, accept=0%) and never exercised retrieval
dev_gate_random_control.proper_test: the RandomRetrieve core ablation in Phase 5, which shares Full's stopping behaviour and differs only in the retrieval ranking

encoders.retrieval: self-built BM25 with per-query min-max field normalisation, CJK char 1-2 grams

controller_prompt.tuned_on: dev split only (40 dev items, qwen3-8b/wmt19_en_zh)
controller_prompt.criterion: defect-based: state a concrete defect, else STOP; REFINE only if fixing it is worth another revision
controller_prompt.why_changed: the first guidance asserted the paper's conclusion ('refining an already-good answer often makes it worse; stop when...'), which drove STOP on 98.3% of decisions and left the experience no room to act -- NoExperience would have behaved identically and the How/When comparison would have been vacuous
controller_prompt.protocol_note: an earlier STOP-rate diagnostic was run on the TEST split before the prompt was finalised; that was a protocol slip. The final tuning above used dev only, and the test split has not been used to select any method component.
controller_prompt.experience_libraries_still_valid: libraries were built with stop_mode='fixed' (forced REFINE), so the removed STOP bias was inert during bootstrap; both old and new guidance ask for a concrete defect, so the stored interventions remain representative

gpu_policy.effective_rule: all four cards 0,1,2,3 may be used concurrently for this run
history: initially restricted to GPUs 2 and 3 by the operator
then widened by the operator to: any two of GPUs 0-3, at most two at a time
then: 'you may also use card 2 to speed things up'
then: 'also put card 1 to use' -- i.e. all four cards authorised
gpu_policy.supersedes: plan acceptance criterion #4 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES in {2,3}) and the earlier 'at most two cards' rule
gpu_policy.scheduling_rule: when a job finishes the next must start immediately with no idle gap, otherwise the cards get taken by other tenants
gpu_policy.why_it_matters: this box is shared with isaac / xlj / zpy / qxr at load average ~200; an earlier phase lost wall-clock because a free card was re-taken while our next job was still being prepared
gpu_policy.recorded_by: operator, after the compliance audit flagged the conflict between frozen.json and the live state

phase5_ablation_substitution.why_withdrawn: the substitution existed only because glm4-9b could not complete vLLM engine init. Root cause was one transiently unreadable NFS shard (model-00002-of-00004.safetensors); a sha256-verified local copy at /home/ymb/glm_local/model loads in ~3 s and is running the Phase 4 main experiment (see reports/progress.md 6.5-6.7). The plan's original two models are therefore used, and qwen3-4b is NOT substituted.
phase5_ablation_substitution.applied_to: nothing -- no Phase 5 arm was ever run on qwen3-4b, so withdrawing the substitution costs no work
phase5_ablation_substitution.seed_policy_note: the plan has the 2x2 at 3 seeds (42/43/44) and the remaining arms at 1 seed; coverage is established at seed 42 first so partial progress stays informative

operational_constants.why: the compliance audit found these whole-experiment decisions were frozen in code/prose but absent from this file
operational_constants.batch_size_note: 5.6x speedup over batch 1 (progress.md 6.3); validated by engine logs at 32/32 controller and up to 42/42 judge
operational_constants.max_model_len_note: matches the baseline's --vllm-max-model-len 4096; the plan's 8192 was a deviation we reverted (progress.md 6.1). NOTE: check_stop_rates.py and calibrate_judge.py still hardcode 8192 and must be aligned before either is re-run.
operational_constants.code_hash_caveat: these are the hashes at the time of recording. Four production jobs were live and a supervisor can restart one at any moment, so a run started before this record may have used an earlier revision. Records produced before 04:45 also predate the batched controller/judge repair retries (audit F1/F2).

freeze_discipline.rule: Phase 7 stopping diagnostics have already been computed on TEST-split traces. Therefore NO method component may change from now on -- not the controller prompt, not the stop rule, not the acceptance rule, not alpha, not the retrieval function, not the experience-library builder.
freeze_discipline.why: reading the diagnostics is analysis; acting on them would turn them into test-set selection
freeze_discipline.already_disclosed_slip: an earlier STOP-rate diagnostic ran on the test split before the prompt was finalised (see controller_prompt.protocol_note); it must stay in the paper's limitations

stale_artefacts.scores/live_runs.STALE-2026-09-12.csv: describes runs that were overwritten by supervisor restarts while run_experiment.py still opened outputs with mode 'w'. Never cite it. See scores/README_STALE.md

number_provenance.progress_md_6_8_status: the unnecessary-refinement rates there were computed on PARTIAL prefixes and have drifted. Independent recomputation at 05:00: llama3.1-8b/en_zh 55.6% and qwen3-8b/en_zh 44.6% reproduce exactly on the now-complete files; glm4-9b/en_zh 78.5% was a 32-sample prefix (68.3% at 800 samples); llama zh_en 52.7% was a 256-sample prefix (57.2% at 1000); qwen3-8b zh_en 36.3% was a 512-sample prefix (37.9% at 1000). The pooled '7344 refines, 50.7% worse' is not reproducible from any surviving artefact.
number_provenance.rule: all paper numbers must be recomputed in one pass from runs/**/*.jsonl once the runs are complete
number_provenance.resume_note: run_experiment.py now resumes instead of truncating (_load_prior/_persist_merged), and reuses a persisted prefix only when config_hash matches exactly; equivalence with a from-scratch run is proven by tests/test_resume_equivalence.py (including a check that the naive renumbering variant IS detectably different, so the test is not vacuous).
number_provenance.judge_tie_fix: core/judge.py now returns 'tie' without engine calls when candidate == current byte-identically. Previously 84 rounds (81 with byte-identical reasons) were mislabelled 'uncertain' because a consistent slot preference was mapped through two contradictory arrangements. The fix is a pure function of the two texts, so it can be applied identically to already-written traces.

qwen3_32b_deviation.decision: the main table is built on 4 models (glm4-9b, llama3.1-8b, qwen3-8b, qwen3-4b); qwen3-32b is not run
qwen3_32b_deviation.reason: it needs ~68 GiB of contiguous GPU memory (gpu_memory_utilization 0.86 x 81.9 GB). This box is shared with four other tenants and no card has ever been free enough; a run was never schedulable.
qwen3_32b_deviation.authority: operator decision, 2026-09-12, in response to a direct question
qwen3_32b_deviation.why_not_workarounds: lowering gpu_memory_utilization, quantising, or sharding across cards would all change the inference configuration and break the single-engine / baseline-matched invariant that the whole comparison rests on. We would rather drop one model than silently change the engine.
qwen3_32b_deviation.must_report: state in the paper that the fifth planned model could not be run on this shared host, and give the memory arithmetic

core_claim_status_2026_09_12.why: an independent read-only validator recomputed everything from the raw records; these findings must shape what the paper claims

supported.most refinements are wasted: STRONGLY SUPPORTED. 55-67% of refinement rounds make the offline metric worse, on every complete run.
supported.experience helps vs no experience (en_zh: SUPPORTED: full_static - no_experience = +0.386 corpus, paired bootstrap p=0.032.

not_supported_yet.the outcome field carries the value (Out: NOT REPRODUCED on test. On the common 736-sample prefix outcome_hidden (delta -0.0024) is not worse than full (delta -0.0444); paired bootstrap full - outcome_hidden = -0.237, p=0.23. The dev-split claim (+5.59 vs +3.91, a 30% drop) is not visible at this sample size. Decision: wait for both arms to reach 1000 on all four tasks, then re-run the paired test before writing any sentence that depends on it.

every_full_static_arm_has_a_negative_cor.interpretation: refinement as configured does not improve quality over the draft on average. This is consistent with the motivation, but it means the method's value proposition must be framed as harm avoidance / cost, and it is only decidable against SR-J-Fixed and SR-J-Stop -- which is exactly why those two arms were moved to the front of the queue.

unverifiable.progress.md section 1 dev table: claims 40 dev items; the dev manifest has 32, and no full/outcome_hidden dev jsonl exists under runs/ at all. The numbers (none +0.00, full +5.59, outcome_hidden +3.91) cannot be reproduced from any surviving artefact. Action: re-run the dev evidence on 32 items and cite the artefacts.

metric_caveats_to_disclose: the per-item improvement/degradation bookkeeping uses an unsmoothed sentence-BLEU proxy, not SacreBLEU; this is deliberate (the corpus number IS SacreBLEU) but it moves the zh_en unnecessary-refinement rates by +3 to +4 pp. Report both.
the per-item metric saturates on very short references (one character = +/-100); 13.7-22.5% of en_zh refine rounds have a reference under 20 characters. Add a short-reference sensitivity analysis.
per NFS stat is unreliable on this mount; trust line counts, first-record hashes and content invariants.

This already caused two false alarms (a subagent flagged glm4-9b as stalled; the operator briefly feared the outcome_hidden output file had vanished). Use LINE COUNTS and file SIZES instead, and re-check before escalating.

accept_gate.rule: maximise the sum over (model, task) dev cells of corpus(gate=tau) - corpus(draft); exact ties -> larger tau
accept_gate.why: the acceptance gate was the sole cause of every cell's loss (reports/judge_bottleneck_diagnosis.md): the judge is the same model that wrote the revision and prefers its longer rewrites. The threshold is selected on dev and frozen BEFORE any test-set re-run; the unguarded gate is kept as a reported condition.
accept_gate.note: None reproduces the historical gate bit-for-bit. The value is a pipeline argument, never a RunConfig field, so enabling it does not change any existing config hash.
